import numpy as np
def rd(px,py,cx,cy,hx,hy):
    dx=np.maximum(np.abs(px-cx)-hx,0); dy=np.maximum(np.abs(py-cy)-hy,0)
    return np.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)

def eval_rule(rule, iters=8):
    acts=[0]*256
    ob=None
    for it in range(iters):
        ob,_=observe(params=W, actions=acts, n_steps=256)
        T=ob.shape[0]
        new=[rule(ob[t]) for t in range(T)]+[0]*(256-T)
        if new==acts: break
        acts=new
    ob,_=observe(params=W, actions=acts, n_steps=256)
    gx,gy=ob[:,234],ob[:,235]
    db=rd(gx,gy,0.232,0.762,0.207,0.382)
    dr=rd(gx,gy,1.622,0.402,0.442,0.05)
    # success if blue touched before red
    ib,ir=np.argmin(db),np.argmin(dr)
    succ = db.min()<=0.22 and (db.min()<0.22 and (ir>=ib or dr.min()>0.22))
    return succ, float(db.min()), float(dr.min()), acts, ob.shape[0]

# ranges
feats={52:(-1,5),54:(-3,4),55:(-3,2),64:(-1,1),65:(-1,1),59:(-1,1),234:(-1,5),235:(0,1.5),236:(-3,4),237:(-4,2),252:(-1,5),253:(0,1.5)}
best=[]
for f,(lo,hi) in feats.items():
    for op in ['>','<']:
        for c in np.linspace(lo,hi,9):
            if op=='>': rule=lambda o,f=f,c=c: 1 if o[f]>c else 0
            else: rule=lambda o,f=f,c=c: 1 if o[f]<c else 0
            s=eval_rule(rule)
            if s[0]: best.append((f,op,round(c,3),round(s[1],3),round(s[2],3),s[4]))
print("successes:",best)

    dx=np.maximum(np.abs(px-cx)-hx,0); dy=np.maximum(np.abs(py-cy)-hy,0)
    return np.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
def ev(rule, iters=4):
    a=[1]*256
    for it in range(iters):
        ob,_=observe(params=W,actions=a,n_steps=256)
        T=ob.shape[0]
        new=[rule(ob[t]) for t in range(T)]+[0]*(256-T)
        if new==a: break
        a=new
    ob,_=observe(params=W,actions=a,n_steps=256)
    gx,gy=ob[:,234],ob[:,235]
    db=rd(gx,gy,0.232,0.762,0.207,0.382); dr=rd(gx,gy,1.622,0.402,0.442,0.05)
    ib,ir=int(np.argmin(db)),int(np.argmin(dr))
    succ=bool(db.min()<=0.22 and (ir>=ib or dr.min()>0.22))
    return succ,round(float(db.min()),3),round(float(dr.min()),3),ob.shape[0]

    h=np.maximum(x@p['embed.W']+p['embed.b'],0)
    for k in range(5):

        p[f'actor{k}.W'][:,1]=0; p[f'actor{k}.W'][1,1]=1.0; p[f'actor{k}.b'][1]=0.0
    p['actor_head.W'][:,0]=0; p['actor_head.W'][0,0]=K; p['actor_head.W'][1,0]=K; p['actor_head.b'][0]=-c
